اعتزمتم (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَمْتُمْ (iʕtazamtum) /iʕ.ta.zam.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# اُعْتُزِمْتُمْ (uʕtuzimtum) /uʕ.tu.zim.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
